candidate.description: Map 16 defined elements (E01-E16) from 02-define.json to the unified template v6.0.0 target structure (24 layers, 3 clusters). Target structure is the invariant set from US handoff — no new structure proposed because the target already exists. Each source element maps to a declared layer (L1-L24). Mapping types: direct (format matches), transformed (content present but format deviates), inferred (partial content inferred to cover the layer), unresolved (layer not present in source).
candidate.target_structure: unified template v6.0.0 — 24 layers across 3 clusters (Identity/Contract/Governance mapped to Thing/Flow/Change). Defined by US handoff invariant set. 10 invariant-set layers carry comparators; 14 supplementary layers evaluated for completeness.

mappings.reason: PROCESS.md exists at declared CTB position. All three cluster headers (Identity §1-2, Contract §3-7, Governance §8-13) present as markdown sections. Format matches: single parseable document with three clusters.

Process table present in §1 with 12 fields but uses non-standard names (Last Deployed vs Last Modified) and is missing 2 canonical fields (Medium, Authority). heir.yaml provides 8/8 HEIR fields. Content covers intent of L5 but column names and count deviate from the 18-field canonical schema. Transform required: rename 'Last Deployed' → 'Last Modified', add 'Medium' and 'Authority' fields.
§2 is a prose block naming what breaks ('entire pipeline is a dossier factory with no output') and the downstream dependency (terminal — webhooks feed back to Process 100). Matches L6 format exactly.
§4 has Tools & Integrations (5 cols) and Secrets (4 cols). §8 has Dependencies (3 cols with status) and Downstream Consumers (2 cols). All four required tables present with correct column schemas.

§3 contains all five sub-components: (1) Two-Question Intake with both questions answered, (2) Input block (4 bullets), (3) Middle table (5 cols × 5 steps), (4) Output block (3 items), (5) Circle block describing webhook feedback. Format matches L8 exactly.

§5 has READ table (6 rows, 3 cols), WRITE table (4 rows, 3 cols), Join Chain (tree notation from sovereign_company_id), Forbidden Paths (6 rows, 2 cols), plus Query Routing. All four required sub-sections present in correct format.

L10 requires three ordered tables: Define (L19, 5 cols), Map (L20, 3 cols), Join (L21, 3 cols). §6 has C&V declarations but NO explicit DMJ tables. The join chain in §5 partially covers L21 intent but not in the required table format. All 3 DMJ steps are structurally absent. This is the largest structural gap.

§6 has Constants list (8 items with comparators, primitives, tolerances) and Variables list (8 items). Also includes mathematical definitions (P(x;θ), r(x), stability) and step-level comparators C_1 through C_6. Exceeds L11 minimum (two bullet lists). Format matches.
§7 has 10 stop conditions in 2-column Condition/Action table. All 6 canonical conditions present plus 4 domain-specific. Exceeds the minimum of 6. Exact format match.

§9 has 7 numbered smoke test steps each with expected results. Three Primitives Check present with all three questions (Thing/Flow/Change) and binary answers. Both sub-sections complete. Format matches L13.

§10 has metrics table (L22, 6 metrics — 5 cols), sigma tracking placeholder (L23 — correct empty format), but ORBT Gate Rules (L24) are 4 bullet points instead of the required 3-column From/To/Gate table. Two of three sub-sections match; L24 sub-section requires format transformation from prose bullets to structured table with explicit 4 state transitions.

L15 requires a 14-field per-step trace schema (trace_id, run_id, step, target, actual, delta, status, error_code, error_message, tools_used, duration_ms, cost_cents, timestamp, signed_by). §11 is a session-level logbook with 7 fields — structurally different. The entire 14-field schema is absent. No partial content to transform.

L16 requires a 7-field birth certificate schema (heir_ref, orbt_entered, orbt_exited, action, gates_passed, signed_by, signed_at). Process is in BUILD so no entries are expected, but the schema placeholder should be declared. No schema declared anywhere in the document.

§12 has a 6-column tracking table (#, Date, Issue, Root Cause, Fix, Strikes). Canonical L17 requires 7-column Failure Pattern Registry (Pattern ID, Location, Error Code, First Seen, Occurrences, Strike Count, Status) plus dedicated Strike Rules (1→repair, 2→scrutiny, 3→T/T). Content covers the same intent but 5 column name/semantic mismatches, 1 missing column (Status), and Strike Rules not in dedicated format. Transform: rename columns to canonical names, add Status column, extract Strike Rules to dedicated sub-section.

§13 has 3 columns (Date, What Was Done, imo-brain Document) matching L18 format (Date, What, Knowledge Record ID). 1 entry. Append-only. Column 3 name differs ('imo-brain Document' vs 'Knowledge Record ID') but maps directly.

§10 has ORBT gate rules as 4 bullet points with correct content (sigma tightening→lock, sigma flat→investigate, sigma expanding→back-propagate, strike 3→T/T). But L24 requires a structured 3-column table (From/To/Gate) with the 4 explicit state transitions (BUILD→OPERATE, OPERATE→REPAIR, REPAIR→OPERATE, Any→T/T) and gate conditions. The bullets describe sigma behavior, not state transitions. Transform: rewrite as 4-row table with From/To/Gate columns naming specific ORBT states and gate conditions.

Campaign content templates are referenced in §8 Dependencies as 'NOT STARTED'. This is a runtime dependency, not a structural layer. It maps to L7 Resources as a dependency row with status=NOT_STARTED. The invariant set has no dedicated layer for content templates — they are variable fill for the campaign engine's Middle table steps, not structural elements of the process document.

HeyReach integration is documented as PENDING in §8 Dependencies. Like U01, this is a runtime dependency mapping to L7 Resources. The secret is declared in §4 Secrets table (HEYREACH_API_KEY). The gap is operational (no API key configured), not structural.

unresolved_mapping_count.measurement: Count of source elements that could not be mapped to the target structure (type = unresolved). 0 = every defined element has a target. Lower count = fewer structural holes.

transform_required_count.measurement: Count of mappings requiring format transformation to conform to target structure (type = transformed). 0 = all mappings are direct. Each transform represents a format deviation that must be corrected before lock.

unmapped_target_layer_count.measurement: Count of target layers with no source element mapped to them (excluding organizational container layers L2/L3/L4 which are validated via children). 0 = full coverage.
unmapped_target_layer_count.detail: Unmapped leaf layers: L19 (Define table), L20 (Map table), L21 (Join table — partial content exists but wrong format), L22 and L23 are present but were not given separate define elements. Counting only structurally absent: L19, L20, L21 = 3 absent, L22/L23 = 2 present but unseparated. Conservative count: 5 total unmapped targets including children evaluated under parent.

total_field_gap.measurement: Sum of individual field-level gaps across all mapped layers. Aggregates: L5 identity (2) + L15 trace (14) + L16 certification (7) + L17 fleet learning (6) + L24 ORBT transitions (4) = 33. Lower = closer to complete structural conformance.

dmj_table_gap.measurement: Count of missing DMJ tables out of 3 required (Define L19, Map L20, Join L21). This is the most critical structural gap — DMJ is the application layer. 0 = all three tables present.

mapping_confidence_deficit.measurement: Fraction of mappings that are NOT direct out of total mappings. Formula: (transformed + inferred + unresolved) / total = 9/18 = 0.50. Lower = more mappings are exact structural matches. 0 = every mapping is direct.
